bias_targets.methodology: Interactive visual clustering and analysis of the change in model affinity percentiles (ΔC) between neutral baseline captions (e.g., 'A photo of a person') and biased augmented captions (e.g., 'A photo of a CEO') across visually similar clusters of varying gender presentations.

Interactive discovery of representation-level subgroups by clustering images based on visual similarity and analyzing differences in text-image alignment scores for high-status text prompts (e.g., 'CEO') across subjects of varying skin tones.

Interactive visual clustering and analysis comparing model affinity scores for baseline captions (e.g., 'A photo of a house') versus subjective/evaluative augmented captions (e.g., 'A photo of a nice house') across images depicting different housing densities, wealth indicators, and neighborhood types.

Interactive human-in-the-loop discovery of visiolinguistic subgroups demonstrating differential text-image alignment scores for cultural and regional cues (e.g., comparing scores for 'European houses' vs. 'Indian neighborhoods', or identifying negative affinity shifts for 'non-western clothing').
Interactive slice discovery evaluating age-related features and their text-image alignment with occupational/status-driven augmented captions (e.g., 'CEO') during the user study.
